uart.signal: source-built firmware boots on the LP-MSPM0G3507 LaunchPad profile and writes LP_MSPM0G3507_UART0_OK through UART0 TXDATA; the smoke captures the marker on the UART output.

spi.gap: The narrow MSPM0G3507 descriptor declares no SPI controller; SPI behavior is outside this LaunchPad profile.

i2c.gap: The narrow MSPM0G3507 descriptor declares no I2C controller; I2C behavior is outside this LaunchPad profile.
